title: Nimble Southern-Thai Tomatoes Kanom Ko
description: A winey, pillowy Thai dessert featuring confit tomatoes and cilantro. Perfect for a romantic date night.

ingredients.name: plain Greek yogurt
ingredients.notes: make sure refrigerated at 40°F (4°C) or below before use

ingredients.name: ground cinnamon
ingredients.notes: use high-quality cinnamon for best flavor

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside for cooling.
In a blender or food processor, combine halal ghee, all-purpose flour, granulated sugar, eggs, and plain Greek yogurt. Blend until smooth, stopping to scrape down the sides if needed.
Add concentrated tomato puree, ground cinnamon, and vanilla extract to the blender and blend until well combined.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Drop spoonfuls of the dough into the skillet, about 1 tablespoon each.
